description_en: Queries the regions where backend services can be attached to an Anycast EIP
description_zh: 调用DescribeAnycastServerRegions接口查询指定区域内Anycast EIP可绑定的后端服务地域
name: DescribeAnycastServerRegions

parameters.description_en:
The access area of the Anycast EIP.

Set the value to **international**. This value indicates regions outside the Chinese mainland.
parameters.description_zh:
Anycast EIP接入区域。

取值：**international**，表示中国内地以外的区域。
